interpretation: Equal-contribution averages (1/3 or 1/4) are diagnostic scenarios, not stakeholder AHP weights or final GIS-MCDA scores.
Top decile is the upper ten percent of illustrative scores, with threshold ties included.
C3 sensitivity cannot prove which direction is substantively correct; planning or expert justification is required.
C5 remains outside weighted criteria until a defensible city-wide role is established.
UDA zoning remains provisional and legally unverified, and is not included in these diagnostic scores.
500m C2/C3 radii and both scoring methods remain provisional.
Current building footprints must not be used as past predictors for historical transition evaluation because this could introduce look-ahead bias.
